layer_policy.live: Dynamic text, controls, planner data and critical/system copy remain semantic and editable.
layer_policy.vector: Versioned SVG geometry for categories and authored visual language.
layer_policy.raster: Only selected brand art and inspected graphic masters.
layer_policy.hybrid: Live semantic control over authored token/vector/raster material.
layer_policy.build_time: Launcher, splash, ICO and widget exports remain reproducible.
